clusters.name: Qeynos politics
clusters.notes: Antonius Bayle + Guards of Qeynos + Priests of Life form the lawful core. Bloodsabers + Circle of Unseen Hands + Kane Bayle form the criminal/occult opposition. Many quests push you toward one side of this triangle.

clusters.name: Qeynos underworld
clusters.notes: Criminal and occult groups; raising one tends to lower lawful factions.

clusters.name: Freeport power blocs
clusters.notes: Knights/Arcane/Ashen form a good-leaning bloc; Freeport Militia is brutal but often aligned against the same enemies differently.

clusters.name: Neriak shadow state
clusters.notes: Neriak's necromancer/rogue/shadow blocs oppose Freeport paladin-like factions.

clusters.name: Faydark conflict
clusters.notes: Elven factions vs orcs and neutral treant factions create a multi-party conflict.

clusters.name: Dragon axis
clusters.notes: Dragon politics center on Ring of Scale and allied draconic groups.

clusters.name: Local bandit/monster sets
clusters.notes: Local zone-level hostile groups with ties to nearby city/guild factions.

usage: Use these clusters to seed faction values at character creation, or to group faction-related options in character backgrounds (e.g., 'Qeynos lawful', 'Neriak shadow', 'Freeport paladin').
